title: When the Extraction Falls
author: Juniper Marchetti
blurb: Dominic Halloran, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
